Layout.localFirstHint: Your data stays on this device. Nothing is sent to servers.

hero.title: Plan your boxes before you touch them.
hero.subtitle: A calm, precise surface for organizing 6×5 boxes, tracking your Pokédex and deciding what to transfer — no spreadsheets, no login, no noise.

features.title: Everything missing from your collection flow.
features.subtitle: Built for collectors who open the app next to Pokémon Home — not instead of it.

boxes.title: 6×5 boxes
boxes.description: Same grid as Pokémon Home, with names, colors and organization your way.

pokedex.title: Full Pokédex
pokedex.description: 1,000+ Pokémon across nine generations, with forms, regionals and variants.

stats.title: Deep stats
stats.description: Progress by generation, type, box and shiny. Heatmaps and milestones.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Save organization rules and apply them to new boxes in seconds.

missing.title: Missing analysis
missing.description: See exactly what's left to close a generation or type.

offline.title: 100% in-browser
offline.description: IndexedDB. No account, no server, no telemetry. Backup whenever you want.

create.title: Create boxes
create.description: Add as many boxes as you need. Each is a 6×5 grid like in Home.

register.title: Register Pokémon
register.description: Tick what you already caught. Filter by generation or type.

organize.title: Organize
organize.description: Move Pokémon between slots and boxes. Save presets to repeat.

track.title: Track progress
track.description: See stats, identify missing ones, finish your dex calmly.

cta.title: Ready to organize?
cta.subtitle: Everything runs in your browser. You can start without signing up.

Dashboard.title: Welcome back.
Dashboard.subtitle: You've completed {percentage}% of the Pokédex with active variations.
Dashboard.overallHint: Includes regional forms and variants selected in Settings.
Dashboard.generationsHint: Each bar reflects your registration rate.

Boxes.title: Your boxes
Boxes.subtitle: Each box has 30 slots, same layout as Pokémon Home.
Boxes.emptyDescription: Create your first box to start organizing Pokémon. You can rename or delete it at any time.
Boxes.deleteConfirm: Delete the box "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

Pokedex.title: Pokédex
Pokedex.subtitle: {count} of {total} registered across active generations.
Pokedex.more: +{count} results — refine your search to see more.

Stats.title: Statistics
Stats.description: Track your progress by generation, type, box and shinies. This page will be expanded in Phase 3 with charts and milestones.
bullets: Overall progress donut with smooth animation
Per-generation bars with percentage and total

Presets.title: Presets
Presets.description: Save organization rules (by generation, type, dex order) and apply them to new boxes in seconds. Available in Phase 3.
bullets: Create and edit presets with multiple rules
Apply a preset across all boxes

Missing.title: Missing
Missing.description: See exactly what's missing to complete a generation, a type or a category. Available in Phase 3.
bullets: Pokémon close to completing an evolution
Suggestions for next shinies to hunt

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Basic settings. Variations, active generations and backup come back in Phase 2.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pick light, dark or follow the system.

language.title: Language
language.description: Sets the interface language and localized Pokémon names.

about.title: About
